acknowledgement: Session B previously accepted v1 call signatures in registration/train_handoff.json. This additive revision preserves function signatures, shapes, dense retained source indexing and arithmetic; B must bind the new contract hash from DATA_READY before its own training. A does not run B/C code or training.

api.gaussian: gaussian(seed, free_count, fp32=False) -> RandomState(seed).randn(free_count,3,3); canonical implementation shared by B/C
api.load_condition: load_condition(uid, patch_id, data_root=None) -> {C: float32[K,3,3], N: int, known_mask: bool[N], valid_mask: bool[N]}; known first
api.load_sample: load_sample(uid, patch_id, data_root=None) -> dict; supervision/evaluation only
api.permutations: permutations(permutation_seed, N, K) -> free_order, corner_permutations_before_face_order, face_permutation; no RNG shared between cases
api.training_time: training_time(t_seed) -> np.float32 sigmoid of one local RandomState randn

coordinate_warning: pre_ot_full * 2 -> model full_target. Do not scale full_target or constraints again. Source rows and corner permutations must follow subsequent B-side free/corner/face permutations. Source vertices retain ALL original raw vertices; normalization bounds unchanged by removal; original face provenance is explicit, dense indexing APIs remain compatible.

files.candidate_audit: data/repair_candidate_audit.json; earlier strict audit is preserved separately
files.manifest: data/manifest.json, objects list with hashes and source identity
files.patches: data/patches.json, records list with uid and patch_id
files.splits: data/splits.json, train/validation/test lists of UIDs plus group provenance

inference_boundary: full_target, free_target, bbox, transform, raw source identities, full-object topology and interface are supervision/scoring only. Model inputs only C/free state/t/N/masks. Build C-only geometry from C. All original/retained provenance and repair labels are also supervision/scoring only.

sample_fields.N: int retained genuine source face count128..256; original_N also128..256
sample_fields.canonical_to_source_face: int64[N], official canonical row -> retained dense source row ID; raw provenance is retained_to_original_face[canonical_to_source_face]
sample_fields.full_target: float32[N,9], row=retained face index; retained_to_original_face records original raw source face ID; official canonical corners
sample_fields.interface: Legacy dense known_source_face_ids/free_source_face_ids plus known_original_source_face_ids/free_original_source_face_ids. Every edge has exactly2 incident faces in BOTH original and retained source topology; corner IDs index model target corners.
sample_fields.original_N: int source file natural face count before authorized cleanup
sample_fields.original_free_source_ids: int64[N-K], actual raw IDs for retained free complement; removed faces are never training targets
sample_fields.original_source_face_ids: int64[K], actual raw source face IDs for C
sample_fields.original_source_faces: int64[original_N,3], complete untouched original raw source faces
sample_fields.patch_metrics: K/N, area fraction, interface count/length and overlap matrix row
sample_fields.pre_ot_full: float32[N,3,3], captured official pre-OT in retained row order; never reconstructed by division
sample_fields.repair_metadata: dict, exact removed IDs/reasons and duplicate retained representatives; no geometric perturbation
sample_fields.retained_to_original_face: int64[N], retained row -> original raw source face ID
sample_fields.source_corner_permutations: int64[N,3], stored corner -> unchanged raw source triangle corner, row indexed by retained dense source ID
sample_fields.source_face_ids: int64[K], retained source row IDs in BFS order; legacy B/C dense indexing
sample_fields.source_face_vertex_ids: int64[N,3], source vertices ordered as corners of full_target
sample_fields.source_faces: int64[N,3], unchanged retained raw source faces in ascending original source ID order
sample_fields.source_vertices: untouched raw vertices, not inference input
sample_fields.transform: recorded official operation sequence, raw bounds and intermediate affine operands; same transform for all patches

status: Published amended contract; consume only after DATA_READY.json
